---
name: New plugin proposal
about: Propose a plugin for the marketplace before (or while) you build it
title: 'Plugin proposal: <name>'
labels: enhancement, plugin-proposal
assignees: ''
---

**What it does**
One or two sentences, from the user's side: what can someone ask Claude to do once it is installed?

**Service or data it touches**
The external service(s), API or local resource, with a link to the API docs.

**Skills and tools**
The skills (and any MCP tools / connectors) you expect it to ship.

**Permissions and credentials**
What access it needs, how the user supplies credentials, and what it must never be able to do. Plugins here follow the SOSA™ framework — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

**Are you building it?**
- [ ] Yes — I plan to open a PR
- [ ] No — suggesting it for someone else
